text_block_list.text:
Some fan letters arrived for Hishi
Amazon, so I
deliver them to her.

Hehe! Wouldja look at that? People
actually went
out of their way to write
me letters!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
There's so many too! This box is stuffed
full of
'em.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Man, it sure feels great to have a bunch
of fans
cheerin' you on!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I can't let 'em down, so I'd better show
out in my
races and give 'em what they
want!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! Time to get
training!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон trains into the night,
burning with
motivation.
Huff, huff...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Okay, one more lap!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this is nothing! After all, "Hishiama
never
throws in the towel!"
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That was in one of the fan letters. I was
just
reading through 'em during the
break.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Everyone who's seen me race had plenty
to say
about how determined and strong
I am.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
One said, "You never gave up even
though your
opponents were stronger
than you, and you held
on all the way to
the very end."
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
There was also, "Never give up on
yourself or
your dreams, and keep
working hard!" and "Thank
you for giving
me courage."
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Reading them all made me so happy, my
chest
started getting warm and fuzzy,
and it's like my
fatigue flew right outta
the window!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
With letters like these, there's no way I
can
disappoint my fans. I've gotta meet
their
expectations—it's only right that I
do!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Heh, glad we're on the same page! Now
c'mon!
Let's get back at it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
These races are teeming with some real
great
runners—they're practically
monsters.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And it's those very monsters I gotta go

head-to-head against. Even if I do all the
training
in the world, I still might not be
good enough to
face them!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But you watch me, Teach, and be my
witness!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'll prove just how determined and strong
I am—to
you and to my fans!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон keeps running for the rest
of the
evening and doesn't wrap things
up until right
before curfew.
